SELECT u."id" AS userId, u."userAccount" AS userAccount, COALESCE(l."total", 0) AS totalTokens FROM "user" u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT "userId", SUM("totalTokens") AS total FROM user_token_usage GROUP BY "userId" ) l ON l."userId" = u."id"
ORDER BY l."total" ASC NULLS LAST
ORDER BY l."total" DESC NULLS LAST
, u."createTime" DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u."id" AS userId, u."userAccount" AS userAccount, COALESCE(m."monthUsed", 0) AS usedTokens FROM "user" u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT "userId", SUM("totalTokens") AS "monthUsed" FROM user_token_usage WHERE "month" = #{month} GROUP BY "userId" ) m ON m."userId" = u."id"
ORDER BY m."monthUsed" ASC NULLS LAST
ORDER BY m."monthUsed" DESC NULLS LAST
, u."createTime" DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
